title: 'Sakamoto Days 2nd Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
content:
The official website of the Sakamoto Days television anime unveiled a pair of additional cast, key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video for the second season on Wednesday. The anime adapting Yuuto Suzuki 's action comedy manga is scheduled to premiere on TV Tokyo and its affiliated networks on January 19, 2027, at 12:00 a.m. It will also air on BS TV Tokyo on January 25 at 12:40 a.m. The first episode will be available for advance streaming on Netflix.

Voice actors Kenyuu Horiuchi ( Dorohedoro ) and Kishou Taniyama ( Bungou Stray Dogs ) are joining the cast as Byoudou and Club Jam, respectively.

Hip-hop unit Creepy Nuts ( Dandadan ) is performing the opening theme "Papa wa imadani Juvenile," which previewed in the first promotional video below.

Daisuke Nakajima ( The Fable series director) is directing the second season at TMS Entertainment , replacing Masaki Watanabe . Taku Kishimoto ( Ijiranaide, Nagatoro-san ) is handling the series composition. You Moriyama ( Megalo Box director) is designing the characters. Yuuki Hayashi ( Boku no Hero Academia ) is composing the music.

Produced by TMS Entertainment, the first anime season aired in split cours in Winter 2025 and Summer 2025. Netflix streamed the anime with multiple subtitles and an English dub.

Suzuki began drawing the action comedy manga in Weekly Shounen Jump in November 2020. Shueisha published the 29th volume on November 4.

VIZ Media licensed the manga for English release in July 2021 and published the 23th volume on September 15, with the 24th volume scheduled for release on December 15. Shueisha began simulpublishing the manga in English on its Manga plus website in November 2020.

PV 1

title: Sakamoto Days Season 2 Reveals Key Visual, Main Trailer, January 18 Premiere, Creepy Nuts Theme Song Artist
content:
Sakamoto Days Season 2 revealed a key visual, trailer, and a January 18 premiere date on Wednesday. Creepy Nuts will sing the opening theme song of the second season.

Studio TMS Entertainment will again be in charge of the animation, with Yo Moriyama returning as the character designer and Taku Kishimoto returning to handle the series composition. The new trailer features the opening theme song which you can watch below:

Yuto Suzuki writes and draws the SAKAMOTO DAYS manga series. It has been serialized in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine since 2020, with a total of 28 volumes released as of August 4, 2026. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English. The series also got a live-action film adaptation , which released in Japan during the 2026 Golden Week (April 29 to May 5).

The story follows Taro Sakamoto, a legendary hitman who retired in order to marry and have a child. He now runs a store, but his past life is not that easy to get rid off. Despite looking very different as a retiree, Sakamoto will not hesitate to protect his family and take down anyone who tries to put them in danger.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sakamoto Days Season 2's Trailer Unveils More Cast, Opening Song, January 18 Debut
content:
TMS Entertainment presented the main trailer and visual for second television anime season based on Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga on Wednesday. The trailer announces more cast members for the anime, and also announces and previews the second season's opening theme song "Papa wa Imada ni Juvenile" (Papa's Still a Juvenile) by Creepy Nuts . The video also announces the anime's January 18 premiere date.

The new cast members include:

Kenyū Horiuchi as Byodo

Kishō Taniyama as Club Jam

The anime will premiere on the TV Tokyo channel on January 18 at 24:00 (effectively, January 19 at midnight), and on BS TV Tokyo on January 24. The second season's first episode will premiere on Netflix at the same time as the television premiere, but every episode thereafter will premiere on Netflix earlier than the television airing.

Viz Media and MANGA Plus are publishing the manga in English digitally. MANGA Plus describes the manga:

Taro Sakamoto was the ultimate assassin, feared by villaines and admired by hitmen. But one day...he fell in love! Retirement, marriage, fatherhood and then... Sakamoto gained weight! the chubby guy who runs the neighborhood store is actually a former legendary hitman! Can he protect his family from danger? Get ready to experience a new kind of action comedy series!

Tomokazu Sugita stars in the series as Taro Sakamoto. Previously announced new cast members for the second season include:

• Kikunosuke Toya as Amane

• Misa Watanabe as Etsuko Satōda

• Shinshū Fuji as Yotsumura

Daisuke Nakajima (director of Sakamoto Days episode 22) is the new director for the second season, with first season director Masaki Watanabe as supervising director. Taku Kishimoto returns to oversee the series scripts. Yō Moriyama is designing the characters again. Yūki Hayashi is back to compose the music. TMS Entertainment once again animates the second season.

The anime's first season premiered on TV Tokyo and affiliated channels on January 11, 2025, and the series also debuted on Netflix on that day. The first season's second part premiered on July 14 on TV Tokyo and affiliated channels at 24:00 JST (effectively, July 15 at 12 midnight). The second part's first episode streamed in advance on Netflix on July 14, and only the 12th episode streamed simultaneously with the Japanese TV broadcast.

Suzuki published a one-shot titled "Sakamoto" in Jump Giga in December 2019, and then launched the main manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in November 2020.

Viz Media is also publishing the manga in print.

The manga also inspired a live-action film adaptation that opened on April 29. Yūichi Fukuda (live-action Gintama , Under Ninja ) directed and wrote the script for the film. The film ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 346,000 tickets and earned 478 million yen (about US$3.05 million) in its first three days. In its first eight days in the Japanese box office, which spanned the entirety of the Golden Week holidays, the film sold 1.14 million tickets and earned 1.5 billion yen (about US$9.58 million).
author: ANN

title: 'Soara to Mamono no Ie' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content:
The official website of the Soara to Mamono no Ie ( Soara and the House of Monsters ) television anime revealed a pair of additional cast and teaser visual (pictured). The anime series adapting Hidenori Yamaji 's adventure fantasy manga will premiere in 2027.

Voice actors Reiji Kawashima ( Fumetsu no Anata e ) and Kenta Miyake ( Boku no Hero Academia ) are joining the cast as Niko and Gansho, respectively.

Takaharu Ozaki ( Goblin Slayer ) is directing the anime at Felix Film , with Ayumu Hisao ( Shunkashuutou Daikousha: Haru no Mai ) handling the series composition. Tomoko Iwasa ( Hakumei to Mikochi ) is designing the characters. Hinako Tsubakiyama ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka ) is composing the music.

Yamaji began serializing the adventure fantasy manga in Shounen Sunday Super magazine in November 2021. Shogakukan published the seventh volume on August 10.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English in November 2022 and released the sixth volume on May 26.

title: Soara and the House of Monsters Anime Casts Reiji Kawashima, Kenta Miyake
content:
Kadokawa revealed the teaser visual and two new cast members for the television anime of Hidenori Yamaji 's Soara and the House of Monsters ( Soara to Mamono no Ie , the anime uses the English title Soara and Monster's House ) manga on Wednesday. The announcement coincides with Japan's Ii Ie no Hi (Good House Day) on November 18.

The newly announced cast members are:

Reiji Kawashima as Niko, a dwarf who travels with Kirik as an architect in the monster realm. He calls Kirik "big brother" and looks up to him.

Kenta Miyake as Ganshō, another dwarf who travels with Kirik as an architect in the monster realm. He is usually quiet and difficult to read.

The anime stars Ikumi Hasegawa as Soara, and Ayumu Murase as Kirik.

Takaharu Ozaki ( BASTARD!! -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- , Goblin Slayer , Your Forma ) is directing the anime at Felix Film . Ayumu Hisao ( Agents of the Four Seasons: Dance of Spring , I'm in Love with the Villainess , Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life ) is in charge of series scripts, Tomoko Iwasa ( WAVE!! -Let's go surfing!! trilogy film, B-PROJECT Passion*Love Call , Hakumei and Mikochi ) is designing the characters, and Hinako Tsubakiyama ( May I Ask for One Final Thing? , Sabikui Bisco , Shy ) is composing the music.

Seven Seas Entertainment releases the manga and describes the story:

Soara is a young orphan girl who was raised by knights and trained to battle the monsters that constantly attacked their kingdom. But by the time Soara is ready to join the fight herself, peace has been declared and her blade is no longer needed. Searching for a new home and a new purpose, Soara stumbles across Kirik the dwarf, leader of the Monster Architects. Suddenly, instead of fighting monsters, Soara finds herself working with Kirik to build comfortable homes for them! In the process, will she discover a new home and family for herself?

Yamaji launched the manga on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry website in November 2021. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in May 2022, and released the seventh volume on August 10. Seven Seas released the sixth volume in English on May 26.
author: ANN

title: RPG Maker U2U Software Launches for PC via Steam on January 28
content:
Gotcha Gotcha Games announced on Tuesday that its RPG Maker U2U software will launch for PC via Steam on January 28. The P2D (Perspective 2D) Map Editor Demo, which utilizes top-down mapping with spatial elevation, was originally scheduled to end on Tuesday, but it will now be available until the software's release. The company streamed a trailer:

The Steam page describes the software:

RPG MAKER U2U is the latest entry in the RPG Maker series of easy to use game development tools. With the addition of the new P2D system for adding depth and new light & shadow effects, create world of rich detail and immersion like never before!

RPG Maker WITH launched for PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4 in February 2025. Both versions are cross-compatible with the Nintendo Switch release. NIS America released the software in the West for Switch in October 2024. The software launched for Switch in Japan in April 2024. The software allows creators to make games with others through "asset sharing."

Gotcha Gotcha Games released its RPG Maker Unite software in the Unity Asset Store in April 2023.

The software was previously scheduled to debut in April 2023 but the development company delayed it in order "to further improve the product's quality and stability." The software was originally slated for 2022, but was delayed to spring 2023 to optimize the software to ensure proper back-end coordination with the Unity Editor. The software launched first on the Unity Asset Store. The Steam version is slated for release later this year with a more optimized installation process.

Kadokawa released RPG Maker MZ ( RPG Tsukūru MZ ) on PC via Steam in August 2020.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog, McLaren Racing Collaborate on 3-Episode Animated Special
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) of the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise started streaming a teaser trailer for a new three-episode animated special titled Sonic the Hedgehog x McLaren Racing: Beyond Fast , on Monday.

The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds game also announced that it will add "Sonic (McLaren Racing)" as the second free update for Year Two on Tuesday.

McLaren Racing announced in 2025 a multi-year partnership with Sonic the Hedgehog franchise , making Sega the official gaming partner of McLaren Racing.

Sega began streaming the full Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond 35th anniversary short film on Friday.

An animation project for the Sonic Racing CrossWorlds game debuted in August 2025.

Netflix and Sega are producing a new children's animated series for the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise . The new show is targeted towards upper preschoolers.

The Sonic Prime animated series debuted on Netflix in December 2022 with one 40-minute episode and seven 20-minute episodes. Netflix streamed the third season in January 2024.

The live-action Sonic the Hedgehog 4 film is scheduled for a March 19, 2027 release. The franchise is also receiving a fifth film in 2028.
author: ANN

title: Reading Our Way to a Happy New World Manga Listed to End With 3rd Volume
content:
Online retailers are listing the third compiled book volume of Chac Choa 's Reading Our Way to a Happy New World ( Yomutabi ni Shiawase o! ) manga as the final volume for the series. The third volume ships on January 12.

Manga UP! Global publishes the series in English and describes the story:

In this post-apocalyptic world, the perfect chronicles of human history... are manga?! This is the story of Mekuri and Kiyoshi. They're on a journey to collect and decipher all the manga they can, all while living out a happy life!

Chac Choa launched the series in Square Enix 's Shonen Gangan magazine in June 2025. Square Enix 's Manga UP! platform also publishes the series.

Square Enix shipped the first compiled book volume on January 9.

title: Super Dragon Ball Heroes Deserves an Official English Release
content:
Super Dragon Ball Heroes released in the summer of 2018 and ran through August of 2024, and yet, it remains the only full series in the franchise to not get an official English release. In fairness to Toei Animation, it is a non-canon promotional anime, so it’s not even a requirement for the official timeline. However, they built an entire card game and toy line that are available for purchase in the United States. The ardent fans are going to find ways to watch, but for mass consumption a legal release is needed. Especially an English dub.

The franchise completely embraced the multiverse concept with Dragon Ball Super , and this property fits right into that. It should get the opportunity to introduce its concept. The argument for and against probably pertains to the fact that it’s just an imaginary world inside of Dragon Ball . When Dragon Ball GT and other Dragon Ball movies that are now non-canon were released , they weren’t considered unofficial at the time. Super Dragon Ball Heroes is already known as non-canon, so maybe it’s not getting the release it deserves. The quick plot is mostly a vessel to move the show forward and into the mammoth-level fights, but that’s what it was created for.

Super Dragon Ball Heroes Have a Ton of Characters Needing a Dub Debut

Some powerful fighters made their debut in the Super Dragon Ball Heroes, but they’ve yet to get introduced to the majority of the fans who only know about the official English releases. The Xenoverse versions of Universe 7’s Saiyan fighters are waiting for their official English debut. Xeno Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Trunks, Bardock and more are all Time Patrollers that displayed insane levels of power in the project while villains like the Evil Saiyan Cumber, Demigra and Fu proved to be elite foes to add to the franchise’s roster.

Multiple characters in the series boast plenty of power, but also a myriad of storylines that differ from the canon. Xeno Bardock’s story is interesting because we get to see what Goku’s father would’ve achieved had he never been destroyed by Frieza while his son Raditz also gets a facelift and becomes a higher level Saiyan warrior. Cumber’s first appearance in the promotional anime also gave fans a chance to see two of the biggest Saiyans in the multiverse go toe-to-toe , and that’s not something fans can see anywhere else.

A New Dub Release Would Help Fans Wait A Little Longer

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus released just last month, but the remake is just a recut version of the original. Much Like Dragon Ball Z Kai , it gives something to get the fans by for a bit, but it’s not new content. Dragon Ball Daima has been out for more than two years, but is the most recent brand new release. Super Dragon Ball Heroes getting an English dub release isn’t necessarily new content either, but it’s more significant than a reformatting of a show everyone has already seen.

Fan dubs did their best to give Super Dragon Ball Heroes an English release, but it didn’t have the official voice actors. The promotional series also doesn’t have an official streaming platform either. It’s not on Crunchyroll, Netflix, Hulu or any of the major platforms. Fans had to seek it out through not necessarily the most legal means, and that ultimately made it feel that much cheaper. Toei treated worse content with more respect. It’s time to give the show a broader release with an English dub. Do you think Super Dragon Ball Heroes deserves an official English release? Let us know in the comments.

The promotional series also doesn’t have an official streaming platform either. It’s not on Crunchyroll, Netflix, Hulu or any of the major platforms. Fans had to seek it out through not necessarily the most legal means, and that ultimately made it feel that much cheaper. Toei treated worse content with more respect. It’s time to give the show a broader release with an English dub. Do you think Super Dragon Ball Heroes deserves an official English release? Let us know in the comments.

title: Yametai! ~Anata no Reset, Daikō Shimasu~ Manga Ends
content:
Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app published the second and last part of the final chapter of Jun Esaka and artist Kine Usuto 's Yametai! ~Anata no Reset, Daikō Shimasu~ (I Want to Quit! ~I'll Reset for You~) manga on Sunday.

The corporate drama manga centers on a resignation agent who will either open up freedom or a new hell to their clients.

Esaka and Usuto launched the series on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app on January 11. Shogakukan shipped the first compiled book volume on May 19, and will ship the second and final volume on December 17.

Esaka's novel adaptation of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga shipped in Japan in November 2025.

Shueisha published Esaka's Naruto: Sasuke's Story--The Uchiha and the Heavenly Stardust novel in 2019. Viz Media published the novel in English in 2022.

Esaka and artist Sayaka Suwa 's One Piece: Heroines light novel series was first serialized in issues of the One Piece Magazine starting in 2019, before Shueisha published the first compiled novel in Japan in June 2021. Shueisha published the second novel volume titled One Piece novel HEROINES [Colorful] in March 2024. Viz Media published the second volume on July 22. The One Piece: Heroines anime premiered on July 5 on Fuji TV with episode: NAMI. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime.
